Full source reviewed: known-length binary HTTP framing, bounded decoded fields/sections, strict UTF-8, final status checks, trailers and zero padding. Length decoding is bounded by available input. Encoders assume typed caller values; OHTTP is outside the selected browser path. RFC vectors and actual encryption were not verified.

Full source reviewed: browser entry exposes URL/onion checks, hardened fetch transport/adapter and labels without Node proxy or OHTTP factories. Main and erc20-simulation browser consumer imports only this subpath. No distinct confirmed defect.

Full source reviewed: per-profile labels disclose content, timing, wallet-RPC, operator and Tor-browser limits; experimental/secondary designations are explicit. These labels do not establish actual Tor use, service ownership, non-collusion or production qualification. No distinct active-browser defect established.

Full source reviewed: credential creation uses a CSPRNG by default, validates injected output size, separates request purposes, and caches only designated session-scoped purposes. Isolation policy and purpose values are checked. A configured random source and local proxy remain trust boundaries; no distinct confirmed defect.

Full source reviewed: stable typed errors and fixed-message convention; class identity alone is not a sanitation guarantee. The current fetch transport exposes only errors it constructed in the request. No distinct confirmed defect in this definition.

Full source reviewed: explicit POST/string body, Request/init signal inheritance, pre-dispatch abort refusal, cancellation race, fixed abort message, listener cleanup and HTTP-status conversion. Cancellation refuses the result but cannot recall dispatched work because RpcTransport lacks a signal. Supporting isolation test source was read, not run.

Full source reviewed: validates finite positive request budgets and HTTP(S) destination, forbids redirects, omits credentials/referrers, streams with a byte cap, races fetch/body against a deadline, discards late results, and normalizes untrusted SDK/stream errors by request-local identity. Browser consumers and full isolation test source were inspected; no new current-browser defect or runtime qualification claimed.

Full source reviewed: fixed allowlists constrain the declared EVM/BTC network reference and reject unknown shapes/values. This validates configuration, not the actual identity or honesty of an endpoint. No distinct confirmed defect.

Full source reviewed: CONNECT authority control-character/port checks, finite response-head budget, status validation, handshake reader deadline and socket cleanup. Profile construction supplies a validated proxy endpoint. Node-only helper has no selected browser caller; no distinct current-browser finding.

Full source reviewed: package-root export graph includes Node proxy and experimental OHTTP helpers. Current browser imports use the separate browser subpath; existence of an exported factory does not establish an active browser route. No independent behavior in this barrel.

Full source reviewed in contiguous chunks: bounded key-config parsing, duplicate-key refusal, offered-suite selection, request/response context framing and generic decapsulation errors. HPKE, randomness and AEAD are injected; no implementation or RFC vectors were qualified. Relay/gateway comparison is explicitly a heuristic, not non-collusion evidence. No selected browser OHTTP consumer.

Full source reviewed: bounded v3 host format, checksum/version comparison, raw-authority canonical checks, scheme and userinfo/fragment rejection. An accepted address establishes well-formedness only, not ownership, reachability or the intended service. No distinct confirmed defect; Tor protocol interoperability was not dynamically verified.

Full source reviewed: profile ids, claims, probe options, self-test result and no-fallback/failed-test gate contracts. Tor-browser and direct claims are intentionally empty. Types do not attest to proxy behavior or endpoint truthfulness.

Full source reviewed in contiguous chunks: profile dispatch, configuration guards, purpose isolation, no direct fallback, self-test gating, optional probe and OHTTP target-origin boundary. Current browser does not import these factories. Informational API limitation: OHTTP only aborts its controller at the timeout and awaits injected HPKE/relay promises without a rejecting deadline race; see report. No runtime/proxy/crypto qualification claimed.

Full source reviewed: explicit remote-DNS SOCKS schemes, rejection of proxy credentials/path/query/fragment, IP-literal proxy selection, localhost mapping and loopback default. Explicit non-loopback opt-in changes the proxy trust boundary. No distinct confirmed defect in the profile construction path.

Full source reviewed: Node request over supplied tunnel socket, TLS wrapping, overall timer, late-tunnel disposal, no redirect following, declared and streamed response-size checks, and cleanup of ended/failed connections. This is outside the selected browser entry. Real proxy/TLS behavior and arbitrary injected tunnel implementations were not dynamically qualified.

Full source reviewed. Browser selection restricted to direct/Tor-browser and single/own-node with acknowledgement; experimental/profile/environment gates and endpoint policies analyzed. Generic quorum mode checks at least two hostnames, not every URL distinct; no browser selectable quorum path. Remaining network transport source and integration review delegated to fresh worker.

Full source reviewed: bounded caller-directed handshake reads, one deadline, fixed connection errors, waiter notification, header delimiter cap and paused socket handoff with leftover bytes. SOCKS/CONNECT callers were read in full; no selected browser runtime caller or distinct current-browser defect.

Full source reviewed: destination domain/IP encoding, port/name bounds, exactly one offered authentication method, strict negotiation/reply checks, reader deadline and socket disposal. Credentials cannot silently downgrade to no-auth in this handshake. Actual Tor isolation still depends on the configured proxy; no real-network qualification or browser exposure claimed.

Full source reviewed: URL-parser-based host/scheme/port/path handling, userinfo/fragment refusal and explicit plaintext HTTP opt-in. Errors do not echo destinations. Node/experimental profile caller restrictions were inspected; no distinct confirmed defect.
